newsitem.title: USA: Trader estimates for weekly USDA export net sales.
newsitem.headline: Trader estimates for weekly USDA export net sales.

text.p: Pit sources at the Chicago Board of Trade said they expected Friday's USDA weekly export sales report to show 600,000 to 800,000 tonnes of net U.S. soybeans sales in the week ended November 7.
Soyoil sales were expected to total between 60,000 and 80,000 tonnes while soymeal sales were pegged at 150,000 to 300,000 tonnes, traders said.
Corn net sales were seen at 900,000 to 1.1 million tonnes while wheat sales were expected to total 300,000 to 350,000 tonnes, they said.
"I think corn will be around one million tonnes," a trader said. "Japan was pretty active last week but this probably will be the last big corn number for awhile."
Last week, USDA reported soybean sales in the week ended October 31 at 894,700 tonnes. There were 146,700 tonnes of soymeal and 18,700 tonnes of soyoil.
Corn sales were at 860,200 tonnes while wheat was at 453,300 tonnes, USDA reported.
